rules: SubagentHandback input.message is an answer; same-message text with another verdict is a second answer; two handback calls are two answers
a handback message that is not a non-empty string is an unreadable answer: it counts, never approves, and no earlier plain-text answer stands in for it

harness instructions are an exact allowlist, compared after CRLF -> LF and trim: the two reminder texts R1 (2.1.312, with the SendMessage sentence) and R2 (2.1.305 and 2.1.311, without it), and the one enforce text E; never decided by prefix, isMeta or origin

position: a reminder is a harness turn only as the turn right after the prompt (at most once); E only right after an assistant message that has text and no tool_use; any other text, repeat or position is a follow-up, so unknown future wording fails closed (NOT_PROVEN)

a plain-text answer followed by the exact E turn (only E and tool results in between) and a handback with the same VERDICT, REVIEW_NONCE and REVISION counts once; otherwise two answers (cannot approve; adverse stands)
SubagentHandback excluded from the read-only tool check; every other tool still refused
a delegation input with name or team_name is refused like isolation
parent cross-check: SendMessage 'to' or 'recipient' the run, or Agent/Task 'resume' of the run -> cannot approve
